work.summary: Member of the Pierre Auger Collaboration. Researcher of Ultra-High Energy Cosmic Rays with the Pierre Auger Observatory

Member of the Cherenkov Telescope Array Consortium (CTAC) and MAGIC Collaboration. Research on developing software tools for the analysis of data from Large-Sized Telescopes (LST) of the Cherenkov Telescope Array Observatory (CTAO), and analysis of Very-High-Energy gamma-ray data of bright Active Galactic Nuclei using LST-1.
